No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Watts printed the hymn under Revelation 21:5–8. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

5And the One seated on the throne said, “Behold, I make all things new.” Then He said, “Write this down, for these words are faithful and true.” 6And He told me, “It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will give freely from the spring of the water of life. 7The one who overcomes will inherit all things, and I will be his God, and he will be My son. 8But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.” REVELATION 21:5–8 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ REVELATION 21
"They shall be taken from my sight, "Bound fast in iron chains, "And headlong plung'd into the lake "Where fire and darkness reigns." STANZA VI
